description: This file is a shell script for testing git cherry-pick and revert operations, specifically handling merge commits with -m options. It sets up a git repository, defines various test cases for cherry-pick and revert functionalities involving merge commits, and checks expected behaviors and failure modes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specific shell command sequence.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to exit with a specific code, used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command and expects it to fail, used for negative test cases.

search-terms: test cases for cherry-pick and revert
